title: Method for obtaining the Knudsen diffusion coefficient
author: Hibi

steps.title: Plot reciprocal diffusion coefficients
steps.instruction: Plot the reciprocal effective compound diffusion coefficients 1/D'*A versus the molar fraction X_A and 1/D'*B versus the molar fraction X_B for each tracer gas.

steps.title: Fit regression lines
steps.instruction: Fit least‑squares regression lines to each plot to obtain the slope (m_A, m_B) and intercept (Y_A, Y_B) for the two tracer gases.

steps.title: Calculate molecular diffusion coefficient
steps.instruction: Calculate the molecular diffusion coefficient τ_mD_AB using Equation (28) with the two slopes m_A and m_B.

steps.title: Calculate α parameter
steps.instruction: Calculate the parameter α using Equation (29) with slope m_A and the previously obtained τ_mD_AB.

steps.title: Calculate Knudsen coefficient A
steps.instruction: Calculate the Knudsen diffusion coefficient τ_pD_A for gas A using Equation (33) with the intercepts Y_A, Y_B and the α value.

steps.title: Calculate Knudsen coefficient B
steps.instruction: Calculate the Knudsen diffusion coefficient τ_pD_B for gas B using Equation (34) (or Equation (33) with α and τ_pD_A).

steps.title: Example calculation CO2/N2
steps.instruction: For the field‑soil tracer experiment with a pressure difference of 3.0 kPa, the fitted slope and intercept for CO₂ were m_CO₂ = 11.286 s m⁻² and Y_CO₂ = 21.57 s m⁻²; for N₂ they were m_N₂ = ‑5.3805 s m⁻² and Y_N₂ = 12.419 s m⁻². Using Equation (28) gives τ_mD_CO₂‑N₂ = 0.0973; Equation (29) gives α = 2.1; Equation (33) gives τ_pD_CO₂ = 0.0572 m² s⁻¹; and Equation (34) (or Equation (33) with α) gives τ_pD_N₂ = 0.120 m² s⁻¹.
